verdict.rationale: Poke is itself an AI assistant/agent, so serving an official MCP server for other agents to connect to is a different product role. All MCP evidence is client-side: Poke connects to and consumes external MCP servers (`mcp add`, `tunnel`, recipes). The probe's 'official MCP server' label points to that same client-side documentation, and nothing shows Poke itself running as an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
